_comment: Map from the SDK ABI (KERNEL_INTERFACE_VERSION, in Libs/Header/SDK/Interfaces/IKernel.hpp) to the MINIMUM kernel firmware version that provides it. An app's config.json 'minKernelVersion' is the floor derived from this by min_kernel_version.py; a developer may declare a HIGHER value (e.g. to require a firmware bugfix at the same ABI) but never a lower one. See Docs/app-config-json.md. Add an entry when KERNEL_INTERFACE_VERSION is bumped, naming the aligned MAJOR.MINOR firmware that will ship it (RC firmware is internal, so use the stable version); the entry stays mutable until that firmware is actually released, and is frozen afterwards -- never mutate a released entry. ABI 0 and 1 predate the first public kernel, so they impose no floor (0.0.0). This is store metadata -- do not confuse it with Examples/Apps/Variants/*/config.json, a different schema. The file's format and monotonicity are checked here; that a version truly provides an ABI is trusted, not verified (that needs the firmware side).
